notes:
Did: migration 20261025000100_phase3_briefings.sql with briefings (id, planned_meeting_id FK ON DELETE CASCADE, prompt_version, manifest_json, dropped_count, created_utc) and briefing_claims (briefing_id FK CASCADE, ordinal, text, source_ref, source_kind document|knowledge, document_version_id FK, passage_id, knowledge_meeting_id, knowledge_item_id, locator_json (json_valid, NULL for knowledge), quote; CHECK that each kind fills exactly its columns). preparation/briefing.rs: PREP_PROMPT_VERSION 'prep-briefing-v1'; run(pool, planned_meeting_id, &PackedContext, now, complete) -> Result<BriefingOutcome {briefing_id, claims, dropped: [{index, reason}]}, BriefingError>; load_claims(pool, briefing_id) -> Vec<Claim> in ordinal order. The completer gets (system, user) like knowledge::extraction; the system prompt holds only instructions and the JSON shape {statements:[{text, source, quote}]}; every included piece goes into the user message as <source ref="S<n>#<ordinal>"> (passage) or <source ref="S<n>"> (knowledge item), n = 1-based manifest position. '<source' and '</source' inside source text, in any case and with spaces after '</', are escaped to '<'. The reply is read with knowledge::parse::json_object (handles think blocks and fences); no object or no statements array -> PREP_PARSE_FAILED and nothing is stored; a completer error -> PREP_MODEL_FAILED, nothing stored. Per statement: missing or blank text/source/quote -> MALFORMED_STATEMENT; ref not among the pieces in context (unknown, omitted, deleted, or a passage past a truncation) -> SOURCE_NOT_INCLUDED; quote not a verbatim substring of that piece -> QUOTE_NOT_FOUND. Briefing row and claims are written in one transaction. 5 tests in preparation::briefing.
Assumptions: one citation per statement (source + quote); B3 can reuse source_blocks/verify-style checks for question rationales. The briefing stores the manifest it was built from as JSON so B4's prep_get_briefing can return it. Truncated sources' kept passages count as included. A knowledge claim's locator is NULL; its meeting and item ids are in their own columns. Columns are knowledge_meeting_id/knowledge_item_id, not meeting_id, so tests/knowledge_deletion.rs and MEETING_SCOPED_DELETE_ORDER are untouched; L2 must clear quotes of a deleted meeting via knowledge_meeting_id. No freeze triggers on claims (L1 rewrites them to source_unavailable) and no FK on passage_id (document delete removes passages).
Learned: BriefingError::code and load_claims have no caller outside tests yet; B4 wires them. A quote is accepted at any length (a one-character quote verifies); add a minimum only if the user wants one, since thresholds are out of scope. A model that copies an escaped '<source' span gets that statement dropped (fails closed). Security hook flagged case-sensitive delimiter escaping; fixed in 189300f.
